View

Click a column to sort, a row to load. N / ShiftN step through the events that match, E jumps to a tree entry, F to frame + trigger counter. The energy is Eν (the leading muon in the Dimuon view, the JMuon energy in data).

t = 0 ns

Keyboard map

Same keys as RainbowAlga.jl, plus a few for the dimuon extras.

Space play / pause
← → step time (Shift ×5)
↑ ↓ faster / slower
, . ToT cut − / +
- = smaller / larger hits
0 reset time
C / ShiftC next / previous colouring
O auto-rotate
L loop
B dark / light
X info box
1–9 camera, Shift+digit saves
P screenshot
V start / stop video
N / ShiftN next / previous event
E jump to tree entry
F jump to frame + trigger counter
H this overlay

More keys

T triggered / all hits
G per-PMT / per-DOM
D General / Dimuon analysis view
A split view single vs dimuon (Dimuon view)
R residual histograms
K Cherenkov light front
U ocean scenery (WebGL)
M music
S hit sounds
Q mute all sound
Y speech bubbles (ocean)
J tour through the events
I PMT direction arrows
W grow tracks with time
Tab side panel
Click a hit or DOM: DOM inspector, Esc closes it
Shift+click marks a hit or DOM, Backspace removes the last mark

Mouse

Left-drag rotates, right-drag or Shift-drag pans, wheel zooms, Shift + wheel, Page Up / Page Down or the ▲ ▼ buttons move up and down. On the colour bar, right-drag left/right changes the window length and up/down shifts it; double right-click resets.

Screenshot

The Download button saves the file. You can also right-click the image or video and save it.
